name: @zuke/gcloud
description: Typed Google Cloud tooling for Zuke builds — typed gcloud tasks for the deploy path (auth, config, Cloud Build, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, GKE credentials, storage, functions, secrets, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring) with readers for tokens, config values, service URLs and log-entry counts, plus GCS, Secret Manager and Cloud Monitoring time-series REST task groups sharing gcloud-based auth, and a Cloud Monitoring canary analysis, all injection-free and testable without network.
